lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
lobby.title: Think like the herd 🐮
lobby.text: A question shows on every phone; everyone secretly types what they think MOST people will type. Match the majority to score. The one player left alone with a weird answer gets the Pink Cow — and you can't win while you're holding it.
scores.herd: Herd points (first to 8 wins — unless you hold the Pink Cow)
answer.locked: Locked in. Stare at your friends menacingly.
reveal.cow: 🩷🐮 The Pink Cow moos over to {name} — all alone with that answer
reveal.tie: Tie for the biggest herd — nobody scores!
won.title: {name} thinks like everyone!
